summary: Header's affixed current item, and SiteHeader's affixed quiet items at rest, keep --ui-text-muted instead of stepping up to --ui-text-secondary. The step was a conformance workaround, not a design: on the old mid-grey dark ramp muted measured 3.66:1 on --ui-bg-affix-floor and no alpha closed it. On the 2026-11-03 warm-ink ramp it measures 4.75:1 light / 5.38:1 dark, so the bar now draws what the sheet draws in both schemes. The contract now audits --ui-text-muted on --ui-bg-affix-floor (replacing the secondary pair); theme zero needs no adjustment, and a brand whose muted ink fails on its own affix floor is now corrected by the audit. Header's needsDesign entry on the step is closed. Visual: the affixed state of Header and SiteHeader, light and dark.
